poses.caption: Support yourself on your forearm and the edge of your bottom foot. Stack your legs and lift your hips into a straight side plank.
Keep your hips square and raised as you lift the top leg. Lower it under control, then repeat on the other side.

Lift one straight leg a few inches without arching your back. Lower slowly, repeat, then switch legs.
